entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' to place an order.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I want to return this piece of junk you sold me. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's Mark Peterson, order number 774-B-991. And I'm telling you, I'm not satisfied. This is the last time I buy from you people.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you received the VeloBand on December 16th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

I don't care what you call it! The whole interface is so **confusing**. It's incredibly **hard to use** and I can't get it to display the data I want. I've read the **user manual** twice and it's no help at all!
I understand your frustration. Sometimes the advanced features can take a little getting used to. For instance, to customize the display, you have to...

Stop! I don't want a lesson! I **expected more** from a premium product. This is unacceptable. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear I will light up every review site on the internet.
Okay, that won't be necessary, Mark. Let me just check the policy for you right now... One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed our return policy, and since you received the item on December 16th, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Well, finally. It shouldn't be that hard. Yes, process the return.

Of course. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
